relationships.evidence_quote: Their hyperactivation triggers extensive pathomorphological, biochemical, and molecular-genetic cellular changes leading to neuronal and glial cell death

relationships.subject: Gap19

relationships.subject: Gap19
relationships.evidence_quote: Gap19 administration in ICH models suppresses pro-inflammatory TLR4–NF-κB and JAK2–STAT3 pathways, reducing levels of IL-1β and TNF-α

relationships.subject: Cx36

relationships.subject: Cx43

relationships.subject: rtPA

key_findings: Systematic review: Cx43 hemichannel hyperactivation drives neuroinflammation, edema and neuronal death in acute neural injury while Cx43 gap junctions can be protective
Selective hemichannel inhibitors such as Gap19 reduce lesion volume and inflammation in experimental models
